svg.title: Valdris SDLC Harness — Complete System Map
svg.desc: A seven-section architecture map showing commissioning, routing and goal control, workflow execution, runtime connectivity, proof and governance, assurance, and trust and improvement.
svg.metadata: Editable SVG architecture infographic for the Valdris SDLC Harness public GitHub README.
